name: Huntress
desc: A pistol and dagger that are compact in size, making them easy to wield. The dagger is light and incredibly sharp, while the pistol boasts impressive firepower. However, due to its strong recoil, it takes some time to get used to.

eff.name: Bullseye
eff.desc1: Increases the amount of Battle Rate acquired by [Lv. x 1]%.

eff.name: Daredevil
eff.desc1: For every 100% Battle Rate you have, increases damage dealt by [Lv. x 1]%.

eff.name: Infinite Combo
eff.desc1: Increases damage by [Lv. x 1]% with each successive attack. The bonus resets when the chain is broken.
